{{dablink|For other uses of the word "crystal," see [[Crystal]].}}
The '''Crystal Throne''' is the seat of the Emperor or Empress at the [[Court of the Nine Moons]] in [[Seanchan]]. {{ref/book|2|34}} It was a great ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that caused anyone who approached it to feel immense awe and wonder. Of course, only the reigning monarch was ever allowed to use it. Its disposition was unknown after the chaos in Seanchan and the death of Empress [[Radhanan]]. The term could also be used for any throne on which the Emperor or Empress sat. {{Ref|{{twotc}}, Crystal Throne}}

The Throne does not require a [[Channelers|Channeler]] or the [[One Power]] in any form to work.{{ref|{{bwb}}}}
